options.why: Correct. It attacks the target and reports an attack success rate.

questions.scenario: An auditor asks which tool an agent called, with what arguments, and who approved a refund, for a session last week.
questions.question: What should have been enabled?

options.why: Quota is unrelated.
Pinning does not record decisions.

options.text: Tracing to Application Insights with approval records
options.why: Correct. Traces contain model calls, tool calls and approvals.
Caching does not record decisions.

questions.explanation: Traces and approval logs give an audit trail.

questions.question: Which evaluator checks whether an agent selected the correct tools and passed correct arguments?

options.why: Correct. It evaluates tool selection and arguments.
Coherence measures text flow.
This detects copyrighted content.
This compares text with a reference.

questions.explanation: Agent evaluators include intent resolution, tool call accuracy and task adherence.

questions.question: Which practice makes a pipeline block a release that lowers safety quality?

options.text: Run safety evaluators in the pipeline and fail below a threshold
options.why: Correct. The gate uses measured results.

options.text: Review the release once a year
options.why: This is too infrequent.
Retention does not block releases.
Names have no effect.

questions.explanation: Evaluations in CI/CD make safety a release criterion.
